verdict.rationale: A government employer e-services portal could plausibly offer programmatic access with scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no API or credential issuance at all: OpenAPI probes return 404 and the transactional portal blocks keyless agents. Third-party representative enrollment and power-of-attorney authorization are delegated human access, an adjacent feature rather than scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
